evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: In biological cognition, metacognitive monitoring can dissociate from task performance, raising the question of how closely solving and judging are linked in language models.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: High task accuracy can coexist with weak error discrimination: a model solves 97% of competition mathematics problems while its answer-time confidence ranks correct answers above errors barely better than chance.
